description.value: A 24-hour Subway franchise on Knight Street in Vancouver, independently owned and operated, serving Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads. Cyclists passing through the area at any hour can order in-restaurant, via curbside pickup, or for delivery. Wheelchair-accessible with indoor seating and no drive-through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the address, phone number, and that the location is open 24/7 with indoor seating, takeout, curbside pickup, and catering. OSM tags corroborate takeaway=yes, indoor_seating=yes, wheelchair=yes, and no drive-through. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging, so those fields default to null.
concerns: No bike parking or rack information found on the website or in OSM tags — required criterion unverifiable.
Washroom availability not mentioned on website; standard for a fast-food franchise but unconfirmed.
OSM opening_hours=24/7 is consistent with the website, but unusual for a Subway — worth verifying on-site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The required bike parking/visibility criterion cannot be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or staff confirmation is needed to determine whether bikes can be safely left outside before this listing meets the minimum WWC threshold.
